items.headline: Big Ten won't punish Maryland-Nebraska game officials or fine Rhule

items.headline: Refs incorrectly officiated Nebraska's final PAT attempt, Big Ten says
items.description: The Big Ten acknowledged an officiating error in Saturday's Maryland-Nebraska game that should have resulted in the Huskers retrying a point-after-touchdown attempt.
